name: Gate Transition
description: A wrapper that switches between views through a ticket gate: two flaps swing shut across the middle, a lamp lights, the content changes behind them and the flaps swing open, all in 600ms.

props.name: viewKey
props.description: Identifies the view being shown. Changing it runs the gate; the old children stay on screen until the flaps are shut.

props.name: children
props.description: The current view. Updates that keep the same viewKey show straight away.

props.name: tone
props.description: The flaps: frosted glass with a water edge, solid ink, or solid water.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. Other div props are passed through. With reduced motion the views cross-fade instead.
